title: Cybersecurity technology — Labeling method for content generated by artificial intelligence (GB 45438-2025)
title_original: 网络安全技术 人工智能生成合成内容标识方法（GB 45438-2025）
summary: National standard GB 45438-2025, published on 28 February 2025 and in effect since 1 September 2025, with the Office of the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission as its competent department. Its number carries no '/T' suffix, marking it as a mandatory standard. It sets the technical methods for the explicit and implicit labels that AI service providers and platforms must apply to AI-generated and synthetic content. It took effect on the same day as the CAC labelling measures, which require labelling in line with mandatory national standards.
key_obligations: Apply explicit labels that users can perceive to AI-generated content
Embed implicit labels in the file data of AI-generated content
